programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh's mom comes to the farm to share a few family recipes before baby arrives  Molly makes pastrami egg rolls as a tribute to her mother's hometown to go with citrus chicken rice bowls and grilled veggies.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh is making the coziest foods imaginable  spiced beef hot dish with bacon jalapeño cornbread  loaded potato skins  for dessert, dreamy tahini fudge pie.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly is hosting a Mexican themed brunch for the Spicy Señoritas of the Grand Forks Brunch Club  churro pancakes with sweet milk glaze  chorizo, egg and cheese enchiladas  charred tomatillo salad  spicy palomas.
